prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in St. Louis — the right one depends on your goals, industry, budget, and whether you need SEO, paid media, social, content, web design, or a full-service partner. I can, however, help you find the best fit by explaining how to choose and offering to build a tailored shortlist.

Quick guide to finding the best agency for you
- Define your goals and KPIs: lead volume, cost per lead, revenue, brand awareness, downloads, foot traffic, etc.
- Know your budget and timeline: monthly retainer range, ad spend, campaign length.
- Choose required services: SEO, PPC (Google/Facebook), social media, content marketing, web design/dev, email, B2B demand gen, e‑commerce optimization.
- Industry experience: agencies with clients in your vertical (B2B, healthcare, legal, retail, e‑commerce) will ramp faster.
- Team and tools: who will work on your account, what platforms and reporting tools they use.
- Track record: case studies with measurable results, client references, and retention rates.
- Contract and pricing: deliverables, reporting cadence, onboarding fees, minimum term, exit terms.

How to quickly find and vet candidates
- Directories & reviews: Clutch.co, UpCity, Google Business, LinkedIn.
- Local resources: St. Louis Business Journal lists, regional marketing meetups, referrals from other local businesses.
- Look for: transparent pricing or scopes, measurable case studies, clear reporting samples.

Interview checklist (questions to ask any agency)
- Have you worked with companies like ours or in our industry?
- What KPIs and results did you achieve for similar clients? Can you share case studies?
- Who will be on the team and who will be our day-to-day contact?
- Which tools/tech do you use for analytics, ads, SEO, and reporting?
- What is your onboarding process and expected time to first results?
- How do you measure success and how often do you report?
- What is your pricing model and contract length? Are there minimums or ad spend requirements?
- Can you provide client references I can contact?

If you want, I can:
- Build a tailored shortlist of top-rated St. Louis digital agencies that match your needs (I’ll look at reviews, case studies, specialties).
- Draft a brief RFP/email you can send to them.
Tell me: what are your main goals, monthly marketing budget (range), and which services you need?
